description: Build the complete public HomePage with dark cinematic pomegranate/crimson design. This replaces the old LandingPage.tsx content with a proper school website homepage.
steps: Create src/pages/HomePage.tsx with the full dark cinematic design containing: (1) Hero section with school name in large Devanagari text, English tagline 'Government Tribal Residential School', department kicker, and CTA buttons (Admissions, Contact). (2) Stats section: 459 Students, 25 Staff, 12 Standards, 520 Hostel Beds. (3) About section: brief intro to the Ashram Shala system. (4) Principal's message section with the name: श्री.बनसोडे अजित लालासाहेब. (5) School highlights/features cards (Digital Education, Hostel Facility, Sports, Cultural Activities). (6) Quick links section for Admissions, Contact, Events.

Use the dark cinematic visual identity: deep twilight/near-black backgrounds (#0a0a0f, #0d0d14 range), deep crimson/pomegranate accents (#8b1a2b, #a91d3a range), warm ember glows, luxury editorial feel. Use motion/react for scroll animations.
Ensure Marathi-first text with English fallback using the t(en, mr) pattern from AppContext.
Mobile-first responsive design - test on small viewports first.
Commit with message: feat: create public homepage with dark cinematic design
acceptance_criteria: HomePage renders with dark cinematic theme (near-black backgrounds, crimson accents)
Hero shows school name in Devanagari prominently
Stats section shows correct numbers: 459 Students, 25 Staff, 12 Standards, 520 Hostel Beds
Principal message section present with correct name
